acceptance_criteria: AC-02: Rust JNI crate (pdfcraft-android) created exposing engine, render, organize, security, and forms APIs
AC-03: Native Android Jetpack Compose app created with full Material 3 mobile UI
AC-04: High-fidelity PDF viewer screen with pinch-to-zoom, pan, page scrubber, and dark mode reading
AC-05: Page organize screen with thumbnail grid, drag-and-drop reorder, rotate, delete, and extract
AC-06: PDF Tools suite (Merge PDFs, Split PDF, AES-256 Encrypt, Decrypt with password)
AC-07: Form filling and annotation layer support
AC-08: Production GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/build-apk.yml) for automated building, signing, and releasing APK
AC-09: Comprehensive README.md with architecture, build instructions, GitHub Secrets guide, and mobile screenshots/features documentation
